description: Baseline: JSONDecoder + FlexibleString + compactMap mapping for 5000 streams

asi.discovery: Approach B (direct KeyedDecodingContainer helpers) is 16% faster than current FlexibleString approach

name: Reduce 4K HLS video playback startup time

description: Baseline: mpv startup with HLS redirect chain (current app behavior). 4K HEVC 60fps stream. Average 5809ms.
Eager CDN redirect resolution via URLSession HEAD request. Skips mpv/ffmpeg internal redirect+TLS overhead (~1.3s savings).

asi.hypothesis: URLSession resolves redirects faster than mpv/ffmpeg internal HTTP stack
asi.method: HEAD request to silksurfer.com, use final CDN URL for mpv loadfile

description: Optimize mapping: direct URL construction instead of appendingPathComponent, tv_archive == 1 fast path

asi.hypothesis: Direct URL string construction and fast tv_archive check reduce per-channel overhead
asi.change: Replaced appendingPathComponent with URL(string:) for stream URLs; optimized catchup guard with tv_archive == 1 check

description: Direct CDN + reduced probesize (256KB/0.25s) + network-timeout=5s + rw_timeout=3s. Saves ~400ms more vs redirect-only.

asi.hypothesis: Smaller probe windows + tighter timeouts reduce unnecessary waiting

description: Optimal CLI settings: CDN direct + probesize=512KB/0.5s + network-timeout=5s + rw_timeout=3s. 33.5% improvement from baseline.

asi.hypothesis: Combined: redirect bypass + moderate probe reduction + tighter timeouts

description: Int-first flex decode for numeric fields (stream_id, category_id, tv_archive, etc.). 37% faster vs String-first for realistic integer data.

asi.hypothesis: Int-first decoding avoids String decode failure for integer fields common in real Xtream APIs
asi.discovery: Int-first is 37% faster than String-first for mixed-type data; string-only data shows no regression
asi.change: Added flexInt/flexIntIfPresent helpers; applied to XtreamStream, XtreamVODStream, XtreamSeries, XtreamCategory

description: Int-first decode on realistic mixed-type data (integers for stream_id/category_id/tv_archive). 33% total reduction from baseline.

asi.hypothesis: All optimizations combined yield significant speedup
asi.total_improvement: 33% reduction from baseline (25,102→16,888 µs for 5000 channels)

description: Final validation run: all code optimizations applied. Average 4771ms (17.9% improvement from baseline 5809ms). Network variance high.

asi.note: Network latency dominates remaining startup time. Prebuffer mechanism covers most common case.

description: Specialized byte-level JSON scanner: 1.8x SLOWER than JSONDecoder. JSONDecoder's SIMD parsing is unbeatable for this use case.

asi.learning: JSONDecoder uses SIMD-accelerated parsing that hand-rolled Swift scanners cannot match
